title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. In continuation with Question #: 16005 Respected Maulana, Assalamualiakum Wa rahamatullahi barkatahu, I am in very great trouble now. The girl whom I got married is having an affair with someone. Due to this she had asked me many times to give talaq. Since I did not knew that she loves someone I had ignored this. She has clearly written in one letter and also told me about this later. I did not share this (she loves someone else and talaq matter) with her parents. Few days before she went to her sister?s house and said to her parents that I have given talaq to her 3 to 4 times. Those people came to my house and beat me and blamed my sister that she has spoiled their daughter?s life. She lie a lot (even takes oath on Quran). While getting married I was told my many people who know her family that they strictly follow Islam. But now I know that they are not. Her father had died few years back before my marriage. She has taken all jewelry give by us. I do not want to spend rest of my life with a liar who does not fear Allah and the Day of Judgment. Please help me. In eleven months of our marriage she hardly stayed with me for 2 months. Please let me know what will be compensation I should give? Will I get back the jewelry (not mahar) give by me? Are there any other chargers (extra money) applicable? Allah knows better, Thanks in advance Regards! 2386 views Q. I am 27 year old girl whose parents are tabligh. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 8818 Country: India Title: asalam alaykum.iam married and ihave 1daughter 6years old.but my wife is not under my control she is always against my decision.i dont know what she want.and what i should do its almost 5years now.i cannot explain her more she alwas says sorry if i catch her mistake.but if make any mistake she tells to every one.eventhough i never make mistake my own its when she does somethiong wronge i gets angry.its then she make miss use of it by telling to every one.she makes the atmosphere very hard 4 me thats why i gets angry.i dont know what to do.pls help me as soon as possible.she is in india and iam in dubai and last 3month ididnt talk to her and she also she always give the phone 2 my daughter Question: asalam alaykum.iam married and ihave 1daughter 6years old.but my wife is not under my control she is always against my decision.i dont know what she want.and what i should do its almost 5years now.i cannot explain her more she alwas says sorry if i catch her mistake.but if make any mistake she tells to every one.eventhough i never make mistake my own its when she does somethiong wronge i gets angry.its then she make miss use of it by telling to every one.she makes the atmosphere very hard 4 me thats why i gets angry.i dont know what to do.pls help me as soon as possible.she is in india and iam in dubai and last 3month ididnt talk to her and she also she always give the phone 2 my daughter Answer ID: 8818 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/1189=L/1429) Make her understand with wisdom and politeness. Do not go away from her for a long time. Give her books for study like Tuhfa-e-Dulhan, Bahishti Zewar, Talimuddin etc so that she is aware of your rights and behave you well. Negligence from religion and lacking knowledge of rights pertaining spouse causes dispute and quarrel between husband and wife. Strive to get her obedient and religious. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
